author: Murphh
body:
I'm looking for suggestions for my new map The Station for Walls.

Here are pictures so far...
http://imgur.com/a/N1xVU#0

I'd like feedback on
* Amount of ores (iron/diamonds)
* Special gear (enchanted swords/armor)
* Structures or details (any railway ideas?)
* Traps

Any other feedback or ideas are appreciated!  Thanks!!

replies.author: Murphh
replies.body:
Great ideas!
I haven't added any ores yet because I was trying to figure out what kind of map it would be more like vanilla or OP (maybe something in the middle).

I feel the mine is "too gray" with the blocks I've used.  Any suggestions for other blocks except gravel, cobble, stone.... for the mine?  Maybe just adding the ores will add more color.

The pun items are a good idea too (Chuga Chuga, Esso).  Open to more suggestions...
Thanks again for the feedback!

replies.author: kycrafft
replies.body:
Please for the love of God do not add any OP items or tons of diamond. I don't want to run across a full enchanted diamond with a sharpness 4 diamond sword, a power 5 bow and strength 2. 

I'd suggest adding a train and putting some wood/redstone lamp sturctures underground. Add a few colored clay blocks if you need to, also. 

Traps would be cool to have. I would also suggest making the map mostly vanilla, so uf ones layer gets all the diamonds they will have ~10-12 not 30. A balanced map will give everyone about the same materials and same chance
